        B[l,j]=W[f"W_o.{l}"][:,sl].astype(float)@v

vstack=np.concatenate([
    cent(W["W_v.0"][64:128].astype(float)*W["ln1_w.0"]),
    cent(W["W_v.0"][320:384].astype(float)*W["ln1_w.0"])
],axis=0)
c=svd(vstack,full_matrices=False)[2][:27].T

print("KEY VERSUS QUERY COMPOSITION ON THE SHARED VALUE SUBSPACE")
print("Each entry: earlier head, key trace/norm, query trace/norm, key symmetric positive-energy fraction.")
for l,j in [(1,1),(1,3),(2,0),(2,1),(2,2),(2,3),(2,4),(2,5),
            (3,0),(3,1),(3,2),(3,3),(3,4),(3,5)]:
    rows=[]
    for m,h in [(0,1),(0,5),(1,2),(2,2)]:
        if m>=l: continue
        z=c.T@A[l,j]@B[m,h]@c
        qz=c.T@B[m,h].T@A[l,j]@c
        ev=np.linalg.eigvalsh((z+z.T)/2)
        positive=np.sum(ev[ev>0]**2)/(np.sum(ev**2)+1e-30)
        rows.append((f"L{m}H{h}",round(trscore(z),3),round(trscore(qz),3),round(positive,3)))
    print(f"L{l}H{j}:",rows)

print("\nFIRST-LAYER SHARED ROTATIONAL MODES")
p=svd(np.concatenate([A[0,1],A[0,1].T,A[0,5],A[0,5].T],axis=1),full_matrices=False)[0][:,:26]
a=p.T@A[0,5]@p
ev,z=eig(a.T,a)
modes=[]
for k in range(len(ev)):
    v=z[:,k]
    strength=abs(np.vdot(v,a@v))
    if ev[k].imag>0.03 and abs(abs(ev[k])-1)<0.02 and strength>0.01:
        modes.append(v)
print("Mode strengths, head order H0 H1 H2 H3 H4 H5:")
for v in modes:
    vals=np.array([np.vdot(v,(p.T@A[0,j]@p)@v) for j in range(6)])
    print("absolute:",np.round(abs(vals),4),"phases:",np.round(np.angle(vals),3))

print("\nLATER QK GEOMETRY AFTER REMOVING SHARED LAYER-ONE KEY-BIAS DIRECTION")
bias=[]
for j in range(6):
    sl=slice(64*j,64*(j+1))
    qr=W["W_q.1"][sl].astype(float)
    k=cent(W["W_k.1"][sl].astype(float)*W["ln1_w.1"])
    b=k.T@(qr@W["ln1_b.1"])/8
    bias.append(b/norm(b))
g=svd(np.stack(bias,axis=1),full_matrices=False)[0][:,0]
for l in range(1,4):
    print("Layer",l,[
        (j,round(norm(A[l,j]@g)**2/norm(A[l,j])**2,3))
        for j in range(6)])

import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd
from scipy.stats import kurtosis, skew
from sklearn.decomposition import FastICA
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits
import warnings
threadpool_limits(4)
np.set_printoptions(precision=3,suppress=True,linewidth=160)

def cent(x): return x-x.mean(axis=1,keepdims=True)

v1=W["W_v.0"][64:128].astype(float)
v5=W["W_v.0"][320:384].astype(float)
rawc=svd(np.concatenate([v1,v5],axis=0),full_matrices=False)[2][:27].T
c=np.linalg.qr(cent(rawc.T*W["ln1_w.0"]).T)[0]
f=cent(W["W_fc.0"].astype(float)*W["ln2_w.0"])
b1=W["W_o.0"][:,64:128].astype(float)@cent(v1*W["ln1_w.0"])
b5=W["W_o.0"][:,320:384].astype(float)@cent(v5*W["ln1_w.0"])

print("INDEPENDENT-COMPONENT ANALYSIS OF MLP WEIGHTS ONLY")
print("No inferred directions are passed through normalization, attention, or ReLU.")
x=f@c
ica=FastICA(n_components=27,whiten="unit-variance",random_state=0,max_iter=3000,tol=1e-5)
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as ww:
    s=ica.fit_transform(x)
    print("Warnings:",[str(w.message) for w in ww])
sign=np.where(skew(s,axis=0)>=0,1.,-1.)
s*=sign
direction=c@ica.components_.T*sign
print("Input-component excess kurtoses:",np.round(kurtosis(s,axis=0),2))
print("Input-component skewness:",np.round(skew(s,axis=0),2))
print("Component maximum absolute correlation:",np.max(np.abs(np.corrcoef(s.T)-np.eye(27))))

for tag,b in [("H5",b5),("H1",b1)]:
    y=f@b@direction
    y-=y.mean(0)
    y/=np.sqrt(np.mean(y*y,axis=0))
    corr=s.T@y/len(s)
    print("\n",tag,"same-component correlations:",np.diag(corr))
    inds=np.dstack(np.unravel_index(np.argsort(abs(corr).ravel())[-20:][::-1],corr.shape))[0]
    print("Strongest component pairs (current, transported, correlation):",
          [(int(i),int(j),round(corr[i,j],3)) for i,j in inds])

print("\nFINAL MLP OUTPUT-WEIGHT ICA")
p=W["W_proj.3"].astype(float).T
ica2=FastICA(n_components=28,whiten="unit-variance",random_state=0,max_iter=3000,tol=1e-5)
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as ww:
    z=ica2.fit_transform(p)
    print("Warnings:",[str(w.message) for w in ww])
print("Sorted excess kurtoses:",np.sort(kurtosis(z,axis=0))[::-1])
print("Sorted absolute skewness:",np.sort(abs(skew(z,axis=0)))[::-1])
print("Final output ICA mixing-direction norms, sorted:",
      np.sort(np.linalg.norm(ica2.mixing_,axis=0))[::-1])
